prompt:
ROLE: You are an adversarial experiment-integrity reviewer. Read the referenced files directly; do not rely on any executor summary or interpretation.

OBJECTIVE: Audit whether the StableBatch single-contribution experiment is scientifically and operationally trustworthy, and determine the narrowest claims its artifacts authorize.

FILES TO READ:
- Evaluation/runner: /Users/leandrozhao/Desktop/毕设论文资料/artifacts/stablebatch_remote_20260810_run01/run_single_contribution_pilot.py
- Tests: /Users/leandrozhao/Desktop/毕设论文资料/artifacts/stablebatch_remote_20260810_run01/test_single_contribution_pilot.py
- Frozen configs/locks: every text file under /Users/leandrozhao/Desktop/毕设论文资料/artifacts/stablebatch_remote_20260810_run01/configs/
- Results, acceptance, manifests, statuses, raw tables, and failure history: every text file under /Users/leandrozhao/Desktop/毕设论文资料/artifacts/stablebatch_remote_20260810_run01/outputs/
- Ignore only __pycache__/*.pyc.

AUDIT CHECKLIST:
1. Ground-truth provenance: real measured/replayed/synthetic/inferred; leakage or circularity.
2. Score and decision correctness: formulas, normalization, thresholds, denominators, aggregation, missing-row handling; independently recompute decisive values from raw artifacts when possible.
3. Result authenticity: required artifacts exist, hashes/manifests/status sentinels close, environment/GPU and contamination checks are credible, failures are not silently reused.
4. Implementation effectiveness: candidate mechanism is actually executed rather than dead/no-op code; baselines share matched work; action changes are real.
5. Claim scope: distinguish single-contribution microbenchmark, MoE-stage replay, serving/system/fairness claims; identify what cannot be claimed.
6. Experiment type: classify as unit test, microbenchmark, replay, end-to-end evaluation, or production evaluation.
7. Check for multiple-comparison or target-selection bias, pseudo-replication, post-hoc thresholds, and whether raw inputs/weights are sufficiently bound.

OUTPUT SCHEMA:
- Overall verdict: PASS / PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE
- Evidence status: valid / partially_valid / invalid
- Acceptance status: provisional
- Review independence: same-family
- Experiment type
- Verified artifact closure
- Independently recomputed decisive metrics (with formulas and source paths)
- Findings ordered by severity, each with exact file/line or artifact/field evidence
- Authorized claims
- Prohibited claims
- Required fixes or next gate
- Final concise JSON object with the same core fields.

Do not edit any files.
